skill.name: longbridge-quant
skill.description: Quantitative finance skill for Longbridge data. It guides factor screening, pairs trading, seasonality, hedging, strategy optimization, and indicator script workflows.
skill.summary: Analyze Longbridge market data with quantitative strategy frameworks and CLI-based indicator workflows.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged CLI examples, Markdown backticks, and finance terminology, but review found no hidden command execution, prompt injection, or malicious intent. The skill transparently documents Longbridge market-data and quant workflows, with expected external CLI usage for analysis.

remediation.issue: CLI examples may be mistaken for executable risk by automated scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Keep examples explicit, prefer help and read-only data commands, and state that users should review commands before running them.

remediation.issue: Dependency installation guidance appears in troubleshooting text.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that package installation is optional and should be performed only in a trusted environment.

content.value_statement: Quantitative trading research needs consistent data workflows and clear methodology. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code guide Longbridge-based factor, hedge, seasonality, and strategy analysis.
actual_capabilities: Routes user questions to focused references for quant CLI, factors, hedging, seasonality, and optimization.
Guides Longbridge kline, option, constituent, valuation, and related data workflows.
Explains pairs trading, cointegration, volatility regimes, and calendar-effect analysis.
Structures factor screening, multi-factor ranking, IC analysis, and composite scoring methods.
Outlines hedge design using beta, options, tail-risk instruments, and cost tables.
Produces user-facing reports with caveats that results are not investment advice.
limitations: It depends on Longbridge CLI or MCP availability for live market data.
It does not guarantee trading profitability or replace professional financial advice.
Large universes may require batching because API output and context can become large.
Some workflows need user login or market data permissions for portfolio or option data.

use_cases.title: Screen a Stock Universe
use_cases.description: Apply PE, PB, ROE, growth, and dividend filters to rank candidates from an index or symbol list.

use_cases.title: Design a Hedge
use_cases.description: Estimate beta exposure, compare option protection, and summarize cost versus downside protection.

use_cases.title: Test a Quant Idea
use_cases.description: Plan parameter sweeps, walk-forward validation, and overfitting checks for a trading strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Indicator Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Longbridge data to review daily price behavior for TSLA.US over the last year. Summarize trend, volatility, and key caveats.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Factor Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Screen HSI.HK constituents for value and quality. Use PE, PB, ROE, revenue growth, and dividend yield. Show the top candidates and explain the scoring method.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Hedge
prompt_templates.prompt: I hold AAPL.US and NVDA.US. Design a beta and options hedge for a one-month downside scenario. Include cost, protection, and caveats.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a walk-forward optimization plan for a moving-average strategy on 700.HK. Include parameter ranges, in-sample and out-of-sample metrics, and overfitting checks.

output_examples.input: Screen CSI 300 stocks for value and quality.
output: A ranked factor-screen report with criteria, passing count, top candidates, score explanation, and data-source caveats.
A note that results are for reference only and not investment advice.

output_examples.input: Design a hedge for a large technology stock position.
output: A hedge objective summary, beta estimate, option strategy comparison, cost table, and downside scenario analysis.
Clear caveats about liquidity, basis risk, and upside limits.

output_examples.input: Test whether a seasonality pattern exists for a stock.
output: Tables for month, weekday, holiday, and earnings-season effects.
A concise list of the strongest patterns with win rate and signal direction.

best_practices: Confirm the symbol, market, date range, and data permissions before running analysis.
Use JSON output when asking Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to process CLI results.
Treat every result as research input and include risk, liquidity, and data-quality caveats.
anti_patterns: Do not present backtest or factor results as guaranteed future returns.
Do not run broad universe scans without batching and explaining partial coverage.
Do not ignore login, permission, or missing-data errors from Longbridge commands.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on analysis, strategy structure, and reporting. Trading decisions remain with the user.

faq.question: Can it use live market data?
faq.answer: It can guide Longbridge CLI or MCP data workflows when those tools are available and authorized.

faq.question: Is it suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guided workflows and explanations, but users should understand basic market risk.

faq.question: What languages can it respond in?
faq.answer: The skill instructs responses in English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese based on user input.

faq.question: Does it provide investment advice?
faq.answer: No. Outputs are for reference and research only. Users must make independent investment decisions.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
